app.skipToContent: Keyboard skip link at the top of the window; jumps past the sidebar to the page.
app.windowTitle: Window title. {page} is the current page's name (one of the route.* messages, or a playlist/section name). Keep "OxiTide".
app.scrobbleReconnect: Error notification. {service} is Last.fm or ListenBrainz (names, keep them). "Scrobbling" is reporting played tracks to that service.
app.updateAvailable: Notification that a new version can be installed. {version} is like 1.1.1.
app.openSettings: Button on a notification that opens the Settings page.
app.sessionExpired: Shown on the login screen when the saved TIDAL login no longer works.
app.queueWidth: Accessible name of the handle that resizes the queue panel.
app.pixels: Screen-reader value of the queue panel's width.
route.nowPlaying: Page name: the full-screen view of the playing track.
route.home: Page name in the sidebar and window title.
route.feed: Page name: new releases from followed artists.
route.stats: Page name: listening statistics (a tab of History).
route.folder: Fallback name of a playlist folder that has no name.
route.albums: Page name: the user's saved albums.
route.tracks: Page name: the user's favorite tracks.
route.later: Page name: TIDAL's "Save for Later" list. Use the glossary term.
route.mixes: Page name: TIDAL mixes and radio stations.
route.profiles: Page name: the artists the user follows.
route.purchases: Page name: tracks and albums the user bought.
route.album: Window title while an album page is open.
route.playlist: Window title while a playlist page is open.
route.artist: Window title while an artist page is open.
route.mix: Window title while a mix page is open.
route.radio: Window title: a radio station built from one track.
player.openNowPlaying: Button on the player bar's cover thumbnail; opens the full-screen Now Playing view.
player.artwork: Image description for screen readers. {title} is the track title.
player.favorite: Button: add the playing track to favorites (verb).
player.unfavorite: Button: remove the playing track from favorites (verb).
player.waitingForNetwork: Small lowercase status next to the time while the stream buffers.
player.repeatOneLabel: Repeat toggle's screen-reader name when it repeats the current track.
player.repeatOne: Repeat toggle's tooltip: repeats the current track.
player.repeatAll: Repeat toggle: repeats the whole queue.
player.queue: Button that opens the play queue panel.
player.queueHint: Tooltip of the queue button. {key} is its keyboard shortcut (a single key such as Q).
player.qualityLabel: Screen-reader name of the quality button. {tier} is a quality name (Max, High…; not translated), {spec} a format such as "24-bit 96 kHz" or "none", {path} is bitPerfect, dsp or none. Translate only the words inside the braces' branches.
player.streamingQuality: Tooltip of the quality button while a track streams.
player.preferredQuality: Tooltip of the quality button before anything streams.
player.bitPerfect: Tooltip of the BP badge: the audio reaches the device unchanged.
player.miniPlayer: Button: switch to the small always-on-top player window.
player.nothingStreaming: Quality menu note when no track is streaming.
player.nothingPlaying: Player bar text when the queue is empty.
toast.dismiss: Close button on a notification (screen-reader name).
settings.language.label: Settings row: picks the interface language.
settings.language.description: Help text under the Language row.
settings.language.system: Picker option that follows the operating system. {language} is the matched language's own name (e.g. Deutsch); keep it as is.
settings.language.machine: Tag next to a language whose translation was made by a machine and not yet checked by a person.
settings.language.crossChecked: Tag next to a machine translation that a second model checked (Chinese).
settings.language.pseudo: Development-only test language with accented, longer text.
settings.language.helpTranslate: Link to the guide for fixing translations or adding a language.
common.cancel: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.
common.confirm: Default confirm button of a confirmation dialog.
common.close: Accessible name of a dialog's close (×) button.
common.create: Button that creates the item a dialog describes (a folder).
common.done: Button that ends an editing mode.
common.retry: Button that tries a failed load again.
common.loading: Shown while something loads. Keep the ellipsis character.
common.name: Form field label: a playlist's or folder's name.
common.description: Form field label: a playlist's or folder's description.
common.optional: Placeholder of a form field that may stay empty.
common.trackCount: A number of tracks, e.g. a playlist's length.
window.controls: Accessible name of the minimize/maximize/close button group.
nav.newPlaylist: Menu item in the sidebar's + menu.
nav.newFolder: Menu item in the sidebar's + menu: a playlist folder.
nav.playlistView: Tooltip of the button that opens the sidebar playlists' sort and filter menu.
nav.playlistViewLabel: Accessible name of the same button (spoken, so no "&").
nav.expandSidebar: Button that widens the collapsed sidebar.
nav.collapseSidebar: Button that narrows the sidebar to icons.
nav.expandSidebarHint: Tooltip. {key} is a keyboard shortcut like Ctrl+B.
nav.collapseSidebarHint: Tooltip. {key} is a keyboard shortcut like Ctrl+B.
nav.forward: Go to the next page (after going back).
nav.myCollection: Sidebar section with the user's saved playlists, albums, tracks… (TIDAL's term).
nav.mixesAndRadio: Sidebar entry: saved mixes and radio stations.
nav.profiles: Sidebar entry: followed artists and users.
nav.showMore: Reveals the sidebar entries hidden below the line.
nav.collection.edit: Button that starts rearranging the My Collection entries.
nav.collection.doneLabel: Accessible name of the button that ends rearranging.
nav.collection.resetLabel: Accessible name of the same button.
nav.collection.editHint: Shown while rearranging. "Show more" is nav.showMore; use the same words.
nav.collection.arrange: Accessible name of the list being rearranged.
nav.collection.line: Name of the divider in the rearrange list; entries below it are hidden under Show more.
nav.collection.lineLabel: Accessible name of the divider row. Alt+Up / Alt+Down are keys; translate the arrow names if your keyboard labels differ.
nav.collection.rowLabel: Accessible name of an entry while rearranging. {item} is the entry's name. Translate the words inside {…} after "shown"/"other", keep the keywords.
nav.collection.moved: Screen-reader announcement after moving an entry. {item} is the entry (or nav.collection.line). Translate the words inside {…} after line/shown/other, keep the keywords.
keyring.sessionOnly: Linux notice. Keep "Secret Service" (a standard's name). Links to keyring programs follow the colon.
collection.newFolder: Dialog title: a new playlist folder.
collection.folderName: Accessible name of the folder name field.
collection.color: Form field label: the folder's colour.
collection.deletePlaylist: Confirmation dialog title: the user's own playlist is deleted for good.
collection.removeFromCollection: Confirmation dialog title: someone else's playlist leaves the user's collection.
collection.removeFolderMessage: {name} is the folder's name. "All playlists" is the top level of the Playlists page.
collection.moveTitle: Dialog title. {name} is the playlist being moved to a folder.
collection.removeFromFolder: Moves the playlist to the top level.
collection.currentFolder: Marks the folder the playlist is already in.
collection.noFolders: The user has no playlist folders.
collaborators.title: Dialog title: people who can edit a shared playlist.
collaborators.loading: Shown while the member list loads.
collaborators.loadFailed: {error} is a technical message (may stay English).
collaborators.members: Accessible name of the member list.
collaborators.owner: Marks the playlist's owner in the list.
collaborators.resetWarning: Asked before resetting the invitation link.
collaborators.resetLink: Button: makes a new invitation link.
picker.confirmLead: Asked after dropping tracks on a playlist.
picker.from: Label: where the dropped tracks came from (a page name follows).
picker.to: Label: the playlist they go to.
picker.adding: Button text while tracks are being added.
picker.newPlaylist: Button at the top of the playlist list; opens the create form.
picker.comingLater: Tooltip of a disabled button (feature not built yet).
picker.titlePlaceholder: Placeholder of the playlist title field.
picker.titleLabel: Accessible name of the title field.
picker.descriptionLabel: Accessible name of the description field.
picker.characterCount: Counter under the description. {count} typed, {max} allowed.
picker.makePublic: Switch label: the playlist becomes public.
picker.makePublicHint: Under the switch. "Profile" is the user's TIDAL profile page.
picker.duplicatesHere: Same, when the playlist has no title to show.
picker.all: Row label: the choice below applies to every duplicate.
picker.keepOne: Choice for a duplicate: don't add it again.
picker.addBoth: Choice for a duplicate: add it a second time.
picker.duplicateChoice: Accessible name of the choice for one duplicate. {title} is the track's title.
picker.allDuplicates: Accessible name of the choice for every duplicate.
picker.addCopies: Button: add the chosen duplicates. 0 shows when none are chosen (the button is disabled).
